Severity is as reported by the manuals. The four source manuals (IOD-7195, TRC15, IOD-4039B, 3P679063) hold the full probable-cause and repair lists — this is the fast index. 1 Zone board (DOZP-6-ADA-A) / zone thermostat CODE 25 MEANING Zone board communication loss SEVERITY Critical 31–35 36 81 Additional zone thermostat 1–5 disconnected No primary thermostat detected Refrigerant (A2L) alarm activated Minor Critical Critical 82–87 Zone 1–6 damper not connected 88–8D 90 91 92 93 94 95 Zone 1–6 wired temp sensor short circuited Differential pressure sensor open or short Firmware upgrade — critical data corrupted Firmware upgrade — checksum mismatch Flash memory failed to initialize Flash memory read/write failed Internal flash memory failure TRC15 may show these as hex (e.g. 0x81 = 81). Otherwise check Data 1/2 wiring, polarity, bias voltage. 3 Air handler (DFVE / DMVE EEV) PCB codes CODE EE Eb Ed MEANING No display / EMG mode — no 24V to PCB "No heater kit" set but electric-heat demand received Heater-kit DIP switches not set properly / invalid SEVERITY — Minor — FIRST CHECKS Disconnect OFF, blown fuse/breaker, or PCB internal fault. Set correct heater-kit selection (DIP + thermostat). Verify S9–S12 DIP settings match the installed heater kit.
